title: Parts-and-Labor Claim Settlement Worksheet: Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor, 12-Year Total and 12-Year Total Plus
content:
This worksheet defines the approved amount of a claim filed against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract, the parts-and-labor tiers of Harbison Protection Contracts.

**The claim and its records.** The claim settled is the claim filed on the contract on the date of handling, together with the service call, failed unit, failed component and failure date recorded on it; the failure date is the completed date of that service call.

**Line nets.** Each line's net is the line charged on the claim's service call less the Comfort Club member discount posted against that line: the member repair discount on a labor, parts or leak search line, the member diagnostic rate on the diagnostic fee, and the member premium discount on the after-hours premium. The labor and parts lines are the ones billed under the price-book task of the failed component, and the leak search line is the one billed under the refrigerant leak search task.

**Amounts paid on the claim.**

1. *Labor allowed* — the labor net up to the tier's labor sublimit for the failed component (the motor, control, compressor, coil or heat exchanger sublimit); there is no sublimit for any other covered component, whose labor net is then not capped.
2. *Parts paid* — the parts net where the tier covers parts within its parts coverage years (fewer whole calendar months from the coverage start to the failure date than those years times twelve) and no manufacturer parts warranty applies on the failure date; zero where one applies.
3. *Manufacturer parts warranty* — applies while the failure date is within the parts years confirmed by the manufacturer registration on the contract's Harbison installation, or within the manufacturer's unregistered parts term where no registration exists, counted in whole calendar months from the installed date.
4. *Refrigerant paid* — on a failure in the refrigerant circuit (a compressor, condenser coil, evaporator coil, metering device or reversing valve) and where the tier covers refrigerant, the pounds billed on the claim's service call up to the tier's refrigerant pound limit, multiplied by the billed price per pound (the refrigerant amount billed on the call divided by the pounds billed); otherwise zero.
5. *Leak search paid* — on a failure in the refrigerant circuit, the leak search net where the tier covers the leak search; otherwise zero.
6. *Diagnostic paid* and *premium paid* — the diagnostic net and the premium net where the tier covers each of them, each paid only on the first claim decided on that service call, that is, when no decision has yet been posted on any claim of the call.

**The approved amount.** The parts-and-labor claim payable is the labor allowed plus the parts paid plus the refrigerant paid plus the leak search paid plus the diagnostic paid plus the premium paid, capped at the tier's per-claim limit and at the contract's remaining claim benefit. The approved amount written on the decision is that capped figure rounded to the cent, half up, with every intermediate figure kept unrounded.

The tier figures read here — labor sublimits, parts coverage years, refrigerant and leak search coverage, the refrigerant pound limit, diagnostic and after-hours coverage and the per-claim limit — are the ones listed for the tier in the Harbison Protection Contracts schedules.

**Worked figure (hypothetical inputs; sublimit, pound limit and per-claim limit are illustrative, not schedule values).** A compressor claim, the first decided on its call, on a tier covering parts, refrigerant, the leak search and the diagnostic fee; the manufacturer parts term has run out and the failure is within the parts years.

| Item | Line charged | Member discount | Net | Paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| labor (illustrative sublimit $1800.00) | $1600.00 | $160.00 | $1440.00 | $1440.00 |
| parts | $2100.00 | $210.00 | $1890.00 | $1890.00 |
| refrigerant, 8 lb billed for $720.00 (illustrative limit 6 lb) | — | — | — | 6 lb at $90.00, $540.00 |
| leak search | $250.00 | $0.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 |
| diagnostic fee | $129.00 | $29.00 | $100.00 | $100.00 |

Claim payable $4220.00; with an illustrative per-claim limit of $6000.00 and $12000.00 of claim benefit remaining, no cap binds and the approved amount is **$4220.00**.
